title: I had fun making a new set of spooky sprites: a city gang whose heads wobble when they walk (free)
author: Efficient-Option-850
selftext:
I had fun coming up with a new set of spooky sprites for Halloween: six city gang members, each in a living and an undead version, and their heads wobble as they walk. The undead ones wobble more.

How AI fits in: the art is AI-generated, and the wobble is a few lines of my own code that shift the head in the step frames. The part that took longest was checking every sprite by eye in all four directions, because the AI often gets left and right the wrong way round.

48×48 RPG Maker style sheets, with emotion portraits. It's a bounce walk, and the legs don't animate.

Free: [https://wonderweave.itch.io/the-wobblers](https://wonderweave.itch.io/the-wobblers)
